description: A high-cadence cardiovascular conditioning movement driving hip flexor power, calf springiness, and core stability.
setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms bent at 90 degrees at your sides ready to pump.
steps: Drive right knee rapidly upward toward chest until thigh reaches parallel with floor.
Quickly switch legs on the balls of feet, driving left knee up while right foot springs off floor.
Maintain a fast rhythmic cadence, pumping opposite arms with opposite knees.
Sustain rapid, upright pacing for the full target duration.
cues: Stay light and bouncy on balls of feet
Keep torso tall without leaning backward

mistakes.mistake: Leaning upper body backward as fatigue sets in
mistakes.fix: Lean torso slightly forward from the ankles and brace core to maintain forward drive
Land softly and spring immediately off balls of feet like jumping rope

rep_standard: Maintain continuous rhythmic high-knee pumping above hip level for the full assigned duration
